Allow the player to choose between sex race and class. The races are Human Angel Demon and Beast. Beast has a sub selection of dog and cat. Classes are Warrior Rouge Archer Wizard and Priest. Let the world have different biomes such as grassy open fields, lush forests with tall coniferous trees, volcanic areas, beaches, lakes, towns, cities, caves and graveyards. Add interactive NPC's in towns and cities that give quests that reward gold and experience points. Some of the NPC's in towns and cities can be vendors such as armor shop, weapon shop, item shop that sell various class based items that do different damage and elemental damage depending on the scaling of the players level. Add different enemies in different group sizes to spawn in the different biomes and let their elements and damage be based on the biome they spawned in. Allow them to drop experience points and gold depending on their levels with a five to ten second timer before they respawn when they are defeated. Add a day and night cycle to the world with different weather conditions. Add various boss enemies, traps, puzzles and chests in the different biomes that grant different class items as rewards.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game: high-definition pixel-art open-world RPG with modern 3D lighting, character customization (sex/race/class), diverse biomes, NPC quests/vendors, biome-based enemies, bosses/traps/puzzles/chests, day-night cycle and weather.

## Requirements
- Character creation before gameplay: sex, race (Human/Angel/Demon/Beast with Dog/Cat sub-choice), class (Warrior/Rogue/Archer/Wizard/Priest).
- Worlds/biomes: grassy fields, coniferous forests, volcano, beach, lake, towns, cities, caves, graveyards.
- Interactive town/city NPCs give quests rewarding gold/XP; vendors sell class-based weapons/armor/items with level-scaling damage and elemental damage.
- Multiple enemy group sizes per biome; elements/damage based on biome; XP/gold drops; respawn timer 5–10 seconds.
- Day-night cycle and multiple weather conditions.
- Bosses, traps, puzzles, chests with class-item rewards.
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them when finished.
- Repo conventions beyond user request are separate system context.

## Decisions
- Built with Three.js + Vite, fully procedural low-poly assets upscaled through low-resolution nearest-neighbor rendering for pixel-art look.
- No external game assets; fonts bundled via `@fontsource/press-start-2p` and `@fontsource/vt323`.
- Start screen doubles as character creator; button text is exactly `Start` so capture automation recognizes it.
- Started implementation from empty repository scaffold.

## Work State
### Completed
- Installed dependencies: `three@0.180.0`, `vite@7.3.6`, pixel fonts.
- Created `package.json` with Vite scripts.
- Created full HTML structure and extensive CSS for creator, HUD, modals, minimap, mobile controls.
- Created `src/data.js`: races, beasts, classes, elements, biomes, enemies, bosses, weather, NPCs, quests, loot/gear, item generation, XP/noise helpers.
- Created `src/entities.js`: procedural character/NPC/enemy/boss models, weapons, chests, runes, glow sprites, animations, projectile models.
- Created `src/world.js`: terrain height/biome logic, sky shader, stars, sun/moon, lighting, water, weather particles, map generation, rune puzzle activation, trap updates.
- Created `src/world-settlements.js`: roads, Hearthvale town, Aurelune city, buildings, stalls, lanterns, fountain, walls/gates.
- Created `src/world-features.js`: chest definitions, two rune puzzles, traps, spawn groups, enemy/boss spawn data.
- Created `src/world-wilds.js` wrapper, `src/world-nature.js`: procedural forests, rocks, flora, beach/lake/graveyard/volcano/highlands/cave props.
- Created `src/audio.js`: procedural ambient music, biome/night mood, combat/UI SFX.
- Created `src/ui.js`: character creation, HUD updates, quest tracker, dialogue/shop/journal/inventory/map/pause/death UI, minimap/world map, enemy labels, damage numbers, toasts, mobile joystick.

### Active
- Main game orchestration (`src/game.js`) and entry point (`src/main.js`) not yet created.
- No build or browser test has been run yet.
- Several integration bugs and polish items remain.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/game.js` implementing `Game` class and expected UI interfaces (detailed below).
2. Create `src/main.js` importing CSS, instantiating `Game`, handling fatal renderer errors.
3. Fix known issues:
   - `src/world-features.js` imports unused `material` etc. okay, but verify no runtime errors.
   - `world.tryActivateRune` expects rune models whose `userData.runeObject` points to itself; now set correctly.
   - Add vent-flame animation in `World.updateTraps` and windmill blade rotation (`world.windmillBlades`) in `World.update`.
   - Check `world-settlements.js` typo/odd color `0x76522ce` and remove/reposition city gate at `(58,6)` labeled `OLD ROAD` that sits near the city center.
   - Verify circular imports resolved; world constants are locally duplicated in settlement/nature/features files.
4. Run `npm run build`, then dev/preview server and browser smoke test; fix all console/page errors.
5. Capture desktop/mobile screenshots, inspect, and polish visuals/UI.
6. Test gameplay flows: character creation, movement, combat, quests, shops, boss, puzzle/chest, day/night/weather, mobile controls.
7. Add assumptions summary in final response.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: missing core `Game`/`Player`/`NPC`/`Enemy` implementation.
- `src/main.js`: missing Vite entry point.
- `src/ui.js`: calls many expected `Game` methods; implement these signatures.
- `src/world.js`: world core; update loops and trap/rune behavior.
- `src/data.js`: all game data/constants/helpers.
- `src/entities.js`: model generation and animation helpers.
- `src/world-features.js`: chests, rune puzzles, traps, spawn data.
- `src/world-nature.js`: biome props and cave.
- `src/world-settlements.js`: town/city and roads.
- `src/audio.js`: sound engine.
- `index.html`: DOM IDs expected by UI/game.
- `src/style.css`: complete UI styling.
- `package.json`: scripts/dependencies.

## Important Context
- Expected UI ↔ Game interface from `src/ui.js`:
  - Properties: `game.started`, `game.uiOpen`, `game.audio`, `game.world`, `game.player`, `game.enemies`, `game.npcs`, `game.camera`, `game.quests`, `game.completedQuests`, `game.activeBoss`, `game.nearbyInteraction`, `game.touchMove`, `game.biomes`.
  - Methods: `startGame(character)`, `previewCharacter(selection)`, `getActiveQuests()`, `getCompletedQuests()`, `acceptQuest(id)`, `turnInQuest(id)`, `openVendor(npc)`, `buyItem(item)`, `usePotion()`, `useConsumable(index)`, `equipItem(index)`, `save()`, `respawn()`, `togglePixelFilter()`, `toggleSound()`, `setWaypoint(x,z)`, `interact()`.
- `src/ui.js` expects player fields: `name`, `level`, `gold`, `classId`, `className`, `race`, `raceName`, `beastName`, `health`, `maxHealth`, `energy`, `maxEnergy`, `xp`, `xpNext`, `potions`, `cooldowns.attack/ability/dodge`, `attackCooldown`, `abilityCooldown`, `attackPower`, `armor`, `critChance`, `lifesteal`, `speed`, `equipment.{weapon,armor,trinket}`, `inventory`, `statuses`, `kills`, `position`, `facing`, `dead`, `basicAttack()`, `useAbility()`, `dodge()`, `takeDamage()`, `update()`, `rebuildModel()`.
- `World` expects `game.scene`, `game.ui`, and callbacks `onPuzzleSolved`, `onRuneLit`, `onLightning`; `World.updateTraps(dt, player)` calls `player.takeDamage(damage, element, source)`.
- `Game` must build scene/camera/renderer, generate player at `PLAYER_SPAWN` `(0,38)`, instantiate NPCs from `NPC_DEFS`, enemies from `world.enemySpawns`, bosses from `world.bossSpawns`, handle quest state, loot, shops, save/load, and first-person/third-person controls.
- `world.enemySpawns` entries: `{x,z,y,type,level,biome,element,group}`.
- `world.bossSpawns` entries are boss defs plus `{x,z,y}`; boss IDs must map quest target `boss_pyreclaw`.
- `world.chests` entries are plain objects with `root`, `x`, `z`, `locked`, `opened`, `opening`, `open`, `level`, `name`, `biome`.

552: export function makeItem(template, level = 1, options = {}) {

555:   const rarity = RARITIES[rarityId] || RARITIES.common;
556:   const scale = 1 + (lvl - 1) * 0.245;
557:   const isWeapon = !!template.base;
558:   const item = {
559:     uid: options.uid || `item_${itemUid++}`,
560:     templateId: template.id,
561:     name: template.name,
562:     icon: options.icon || (isWeapon ? (WEAPON_ICONS[options.classId] || '⚔') : '❖'),
563:     type: isWeapon ? 'weapon' : 'armor',
564:     slot: isWeapon ? 'weapon' : 'armor',
565:     element: template.element || 'physical',
566:     rarity: rarityId,
567:     level: lvl,
568:     desc: template.desc || 'A relic of the Sundered Realms.',
569:     classId: options.classId || null,
570:     price: Math.round((isWeapon ? 48 : 40) * rarity.mult + lvl * (isWeapon ? 16 : 14) * rarity.mult),
571:     damage: isWeapon ? Math.round((template.base + lvl * 2.1) * rarity.mult) : 0,
572:     elementPower: isWeapon ? Math.round((template.base * 0.33 + lvl * 0.8) * rarity.mult) : 0,
573:     health: template.health ? Math.round(template.health * (1 + (lvl - 1) * 0.16) * rarity.mult) : 0,
574:     armor: template.armor ? Math.round(template.armor * (1 + (lvl - 1) * 0.14) * rarity.mult) : 0,

578:     trinket: false,

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game: high-definition pixel-art open-world RPG with modern 3D lighting, character customization (sex/race/class), diverse biomes, NPC quests/vendors, biome-based enemies, bosses/traps/puzzles/chests, day-night cycle and weather.

## Requirements
- Character creation before gameplay: sex, race (Human/Angel/Demon/Beast with Dog/Cat sub-choice), class (Warrior/Rogue/Archer/Wizard/Priest).
- Worlds/biomes: grassy fields, coniferous forests, volcano, beach, lake, towns, cities, caves, graveyards.
- Interactive town/city NPCs give quests rewarding gold/XP; vendors sell class-based weapons/armor/items with level-scaling damage and elemental damage.
- Multiple enemy group sizes per biome; elements/damage based on biome; XP/gold drops; respawn timer 5–10 seconds.
- Day-night cycle and multiple weather conditions.
- Bosses, traps, puzzles, chests with class-item rewards.
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Built with Three.js + Vite, fully procedural low-poly assets upscaled through low-resolution nearest-neighbor rendering for pixel-art look.
- No external game assets; fonts bundled via `@fontsource/press-start-2p` and `@fontsource/vt323`.
- Start screen doubles as character creator; button text is exactly `Start` so capture automation recognizes it.
- Third-person action camera with drag-look and wheel zoom; preview orbit before starting.
- Save system uses localStorage key `aetherfall_save_v2`; a dynamically injected `Continue` button resumes saved progress, while `Start` always begins a new hero.

## Work State
### Completed
- Installed dependencies: `three@0.180.0`, `vite@7.3.6`, pixel fonts.
- Created `package.json` with Vite scripts.
- Created full HTML structure and extensive CSS for creator, HUD, modals, minimap, mobile controls.
- Created `src/data.js`: races, beasts, classes, elements, biomes, enemies, bosses, weather, NPCs, quests, loot/gear, item generation, XP/noise helpers.
- Created `src/entities.js`: procedural character/NPC/enemy/boss models, weapons, chests, runes, glow sprites, animations, projectile models.
- Created `src/world.js`: terrain height/biome logic, sky shader, stars, sun/moon, lighting, water, weather particles, map generation, rune puzzle activation, trap updates.
- Created `src/world-settlements.js`, `src/world-features.js`, `src/world-wilds.js`, `src/world-nature.js`.
- Created `src/audio.js`, `src/ui.js`, `src/style.css`, `index.html`.
- Created `src/game.js` with:
  - `Game` renderer/scene/camera setup, preview character creator, start/continue/save/applySave.
  - Quest lifecycle (`initQuests`, `acceptQuest`, `turnInQuest`, `registerKill`, `registerPuzzle`, `getActiveQuests`, `getCompletedQuests`).
  - NPC creation/markers, enemy/boss spawning, interaction detection, chest/rune/vendor/item logic.
  - Weather/day-night updates, camera, input handling, projectiles, timers, effects, boss aggro, death/respawn.
  - `Player` class: stats/equipment, XP/leveling, combat, abilities, dodge, statuses, movement/collision, damage/healing.
- Created `src/main.js` importing CSS, instantiating `Game`, handling fatal renderer errors.

### Active
- No build or browser test has been run yet.
- Need to fix known integration/runtime bugs before verification.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Fix known issues:
   - `src/world.js`: animate vent flames in `updateTraps`; rotate `world.windmillBlades` in `World.update`.
   - `src/world-settlements.js`: fix invalid color `0x76522ce`; remove/reposition city gate at `(58,6)` labeled `OLD ROAD` near city center.
   - Fix wall colliders with radius 13 at `(58,28.2)` and `(58,-21.8)` which block the city gate/plaza; replace with segmented/thin colliders.
   - Verify `World.tryActivateRune`/rune reset and `createNpcMarker` texture sharing.
   - Check circular imports and duplicated world constants.
2. Run `npm run build`, then dev/preview server and browser smoke test; fix all console/page errors.
3. Capture desktop/mobile screenshots, inspect, and polish visuals/UI.
4. Test gameplay flows: character creation, movement, combat, quests, shops, boss, puzzle/chest, day/night/weather, mobile controls, continue/save.
5. Add assumptions summary in final response.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: core orchestration, Player, NPC/Enemy classes (just written, untested).
- `src/main.js`: Vite entry, creates Game and catches fatal errors.
- `src/ui.js`: expected Game/Player interface; calls many game methods.
- `src/world.js`: world core, update loops, traps/runes.
- `src/entities.js`: model generation and animation helpers.
- `src/data.js`: game data, classes, quests, enemies, loot.
- `src/world-features.js`: chests, puzzle runes, traps, spawn data.
- `src/world-settlements.js`: town/city buildings, walls, gates, colliders.
- `src/world-nature.js`: forests, rocks, flora, cave props, windmill.
- `src/audio.js`: procedural audio engine.
- `index.html`: DOM IDs expected by UI/game.
- `src/style.css`: UI styling.
- `package.json`: scripts/dependencies.

## Important Context
- Expected UI ↔ Game interface:
  - Properties: `game.started`, `game.uiOpen`, `game.audio`, `game.world`, `game.player`, `game.enemies`, `game.npcs`, `game.camera`, `game.quests`, `game.completedQuests`, `game.activeBoss`, `game.nearbyInteraction`, `game.touchMove`, `game.biomes`.
  - Methods: `startGame(character)`, `previewCharacter(selection)`, `getActiveQuests()`, `getCompletedQuests()`, `acceptQuest(id)`, `turnInQuest(id)`, `openVendor(npc)`, `buyItem(item)`, `usePotion()`, `useConsumable(index)`, `equipItem(index)`, `save()`, `respawn()`, `togglePixelFilter()`, `toggleSound()`, `setWaypoint(x,z)`, `interact()`.
- Player fields consumed by UI: `name`, `level`, `gold`, `classId`, `className`, `race`, `raceName`, `beastName`, `health`, `maxHealth`, `energy`, `maxEnergy`, `xp`, `xpNext`, `potions`, `cooldowns.attack/ability/dodge`, `attackCooldown`, `abilityCooldown`, `attackPower`, `armor`, `critChance`, `lifesteal`, `speed`, `equipment.{weapon,armor,trinket}`, `inventory`, `statuses`, `kills`, `position`, `facing`, `dead`, `basicAttack()`, `useAbility()`, `dodge()`, `takeDamage()`, `update()`, `rebuildModel()`.
- `World` expects `game.scene`, `game.ui`, callbacks `onPuzzleSolved`, `onRuneLit`, `onLightning`; `World.updateTraps(dt, player)` calls `player.takeDamage(damage, element, source)`.
- `world.enemySpawns` entries: `{x,z,y,type,level,biome,element,group}`; `world.bossSpawns` boss defs plus `{x,z,y}`; boss quest target `boss_pyreclaw`.
- `world.chests` entries have `root,x,z,locked,opened,opening,open,level,name,biome`.
- `world.puzzleRunes` are Three.js rune models with `userData.{puzzleId,element,name,lit,runeObject,x,z}`.
- `World.tryActivateRune(model)` returns `{result:'lit'|'reset'|'solved'|'ignored', progress, total}`.
- Mobile controls rely on `game.touchMove` being a `THREE.Vector2`; joystick writes normalized x/y.
- Start capture auto-clicks exact `Start`; preserve button label.
- All changes are uncommitted; project had no prior app files.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:

  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game: high-definition pixel-art open-world RPG with modern 3D lighting, character customization, diverse biomes, NPC quests/vendors, enemies/bosses, puzzles/chests, day-night cycle, weather, and mobile support.

## Requirements
- Character creation before gameplay: sex, race (Human/Angel/Demon/Beast with Dog/Cat sub-choice), class (Warrior/Rogue/Archer/Wizard/Priest).
- Biomes: grassy fields, coniferous forest, volcano, beach, lake, towns, cities, caves, graveyard.
- Town/city NPCs give quests rewarding gold/XP; vendors sell class-based weapons/armor/items with level-scaling and elemental damage.
- Multiple enemy group sizes per biome; biome-based elements/damage; XP/gold drops; respawn timer 5–10 seconds.
- Day-night cycle and multiple weather conditions.
- Bosses, traps, puzzles, chests with class-item rewards.
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Three.js + Vite; all assets procedural low-poly models rendered at reduced resolution with nearest-neighbor upscaling for pixel-art look.
- No external game assets; bundled `@fontsource/press-start-2p` and `@fontsource/vt323`.
- Start screen doubles as character creator; visible button text must remain exactly `Start` for capture automation.
- Third-person action camera with drag-look and wheel zoom; orbiting preview before starting.
- Save key `aetherfall_save_v2`; injected `Continue` resumes saved progress, `Start` always begins a new hero.
- Production build uses `vite build --base ./`; preview runs at `http://localhost:3000`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Dependencies and package scripts configured.
- Full HTML/CSS UI, HUD, modals, minimap, and mobile controls created.
- `src/data.js`, `src/entities.js`, `src/world*.js`, `src/audio.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/style.css` implemented.
- **Missing `src/main.js` created** with CSS import, `Game` bootstrap, `window.aetherfall`, HMR cleanup, and WebGL failure notice.
- **Missing `NPC` and `Enemy` classes implemented** in `src/game.js`; previously caused fatal `ReferenceError: NPC is not defined`.
- Fixed `src/world-settlements.js`: invalid color `0x76522ce` → `0x76522c`, removed central `OLD ROAD` gate, replaced radius-13 city-wall colliders with overlapping thin colliders leaving the south gate open.
- Added windmill blade rotation and fire-vent flame animation in `src/world.js`.
- Fixed duplicate zone labels: `Game.update()` now derives settlement names and `UI.updateZone()` hides duplicate biome text.
- Added inline SVG favicon to eliminate `/favicon.ico` 404.
- Improved vendor stock: level-appropriate distinct items instead of four duplicates; reduced item prices for low-level affordability.
- Capped boss visual scale at `2.5` to prevent oversized models.
- `npm run build` succeeds (only chunk-size warning).
- Browser smoke tests pass: start screen, character creation, gameplay start, dialogue/quest accept, combat damage/death/XP/quest progress, quest turn-in, chest opening, rune puzzle solve/reward, vendor purchase/equip/stat changes, boss aggro/HUD, storm/night/rain rendering, respawn logic, and mobile layout.
- No runtime console errors after fixes (only WebGL SwiftShader performance warnings).

### Active
- Mobile HUD polish: touch `interact` button overlaps/hides behind the attack button at 390×844.
- Verify mobile joystick movement and all touch actions.
- Test save/continue flow and day-night/weather transitions more thoroughly.
- Capture final desktop/mobile screenshots and polish visuals/UI.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Fix mobile touch layout so interact, ability, attack, and dodge do not overlap; current boxes at 390×844: interact `[329,789,42,42]`, ability `[257,721,55,55]`, attack `[308,753,68,68]`, dodge `[329,702,45,45]`.
2. Re-run `npm run build`, reload preview, and browser-test mobile joystick plus every touch button.
3. Test save/continue: reload after autosave, click `Continue`, verify player stats/equipment/quests/chests restore.
4. Test weather/time transitions, death/respawn, boss defeat reward, and remaining quest/vendor flows.
5. Capture desktop `1440×900` and mobile `390×844` screenshots; inspect and polish final presentation.
6. Add assumptions summary in final response.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: Game orchestration, Player, new NPC/Enemy/Boss logic, combat, quests, input, save system.
- `src/ui.js`: DOM HUD/modal logic; `updateZone` duplicate-label fix.
- `src/world.js`: world update loop, traps, runes, weather/day-night, windmill animation.
- `src/world-settlements.js`: towns/city, wall colliders, buildings, gates.
- `src/world-features.js`: chests, puzzles, traps, enemy/boss spawns.
- `src/world-nature.js`: trees, volcano, cave, windmill, scenery.
- `src/data.js`: races/classes/biomes/enemies/bosses/quests/shops/item generation.
- `src/entities.js`: procedural character/enemy/chest/rune/projectile models.
- `src/main.js`: Vite entry/bootstrap.
- `src/style.css`: UI, HUD, responsive/mobile styles.
- `index.html`: DOM structure and favicon.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and dependencies.

## Important Context
- Expected UI ↔ Game interface is implemented; `game.started`, `game.uiOpen`, `game.player`, `game.enemies`, `game.npcs`, `game.world`, `game.audio`, etc. are live.
- `window.aetherfall` exposes the running `Game` for browser evaluation.

- Capture automation auto-clicks the visible button whose label matches `/^(?:start|play)(?:\s+(?:game|now))?$/i`; keep `Start` intact.
- All changes are uncommitted; repo had no prior application files.
